author: Will_eliwood
quote: 10/10. The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is an absolute masterpiece. Its world, music, dungeons, and sense of adventure are unforgettable. Even after all these years, its level design and storytelling are better than most modern games. A timeless classic that truly deserves its legendary reputation.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Will_eliwood
quote: GTA 6 looks visually impressive, but I'm worried Rockstar is focusing too much on graphics and realism rather than actual gameplay innovation. A bigger open world doesn't necessarily mean a better game, especially if the missions still feel repetitive and overly scripted.

author: Will_eliwood
quote:
Metroid 4: Beyond feels like the moment the series has been aiming for, a perfectly balanced mix of exploration, combat, and atmosphere that stays strong from start to finish. Every area is crafted with intention, filled with secrets that genuinely reward curiosity, and the overall pacing is spot on.

Samus moves with impressive fluidity, turning simple traversal into something genuinely addictive. Boss fights stand out for their creativity, not just their challenge, using mechanics that demand attention and create memorable encounters. The music and sound effects add real weight to every scene, enhancing the sense of immersion.

It is rare to find a game this consistent and confident in its identity. Metroid 4: Beyond does not just uphold the legacy of the franchise, it raises the standard. A score of 100 feels fully deserved.
